text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon ended up needing 
supplementary lessons in home economics. 
Curious since it's so rare for her, I went 
to check on her—

Sitting alongside Sakura Bakushin O at 
their own sewing machines, they appeared 
to be making drawstring pouches.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The sewing machine has stopped. Thread 
fraying detected for the ninth time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Estimated time to untangle and resolve 
the snag: approximately 15 minutes."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~! I sewed the opening of the bag 
shut again~! What is with this difficulty 
level! This has gotta be—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can only consider this a trial from God! 
Yes, a trial for me, the lovely class 
representative!

A pile of failures stacked in the corner, 
sweat glistening on their foreheads... It 
seems both of them are struggling quite a 
bit.
choice_data_list: Looks like you have your hands full.
Looks like you have your hands full.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, thank you for your hard work. As 
you stated, this mission is proving harder 
than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if we don't clear it today, 
there's a chance we'll have remedial 
lessons tomorrow as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will fix the fraying immediately. 
Presumably, by removing the thread—
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hyek!? What was that just now!? Was that 
an ominous snapping sound!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Bobbin and needle threads snapped. 
Repair method: Unknown. Inflicted with 
status condition: 'Hopeless.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, how clumsy of you! In that case, 
I shall lend you my honorable sewing 
machine!"

Puffing out her chest with pride, Sakura 
Bakushin O snatched the fabric from the 
sewing machine with great momentum.
(CLANG)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaah!? The needle, the needle 
brokeeeーー!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Bad Status: 'Desperate Crisis'

Faced with such an unexpected turn of 
events, even Mihono Bourbon seemed visibly 
perplexed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Initiating rest period for 
relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, the sakura mochi was so, so, so 
chewy! It's only fitting since it shares 
part of my name!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Bourbon-san, there is 
a very famous proverb involving "mochi"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If I remember right, uh! Um! Mochi... 
mochi-mochi-mocchi...?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the proverb "leave it to the 
experts"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, that's it! It was right on the 
tip of my tongue too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what is it, Bourbon? Staring so 
intently at my face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ......Status "Inspiration" triggered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! "Leave rice cakes to the mochi 
maker, and sewing to the sewing maker"—I 
mean, to the teacher!

text_block_list.name: Home Economics Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hey, move your hands, not your mouth. 
...Bourbon-san, you're doing great.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sensei.

With the home ec teacher helping fix the 
sewing machine, she successfully finished 
sewing the drawstring pouch!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"If it is hand-sewn, I believe I can 
create it as well. Switching quickly to 
hand-sewing method."

Holding the needle, Mihono Bourbon began 
to sew with precise spacing and speed...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —It is finished.

A drawstring pouch with stitches so even 
you wouldn't believe it was hand-sewn was 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ngghh~~! As class representative, I refuse 
to be beaten by homework!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll use all 19 hand-stitching methods 
listed in the textbook to sew this up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And heave-ho! Running stitch! Backstitch! 
Herringbone stitch! Bakushin, Bakuuu-shin!

After that, one way or another, the 
hand-sewn drawstring pouch was 
successfully completed. However—

text_block_list.name: Home Economics Teacher
text_block_list.text: This is... hand-sewn, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was difficult to do with a sewing 
machine, so I did it by hand.

text_block_list.name: Home Economics Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Normally this would be a 
disqualification—however, these even 
stitches and variety of techniques clearly 
show how hard you two worked."

text_block_list.name: Home Economics Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And so, you've passed the supplementary 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu! But of course! Behold our 
exemplary Class! Rep! Resen! Tative!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sensei.

And so, after many twists and turns, she 
successfully passed the makeup lessons.
